info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Historical Transactions Aggregation API
info.description: The Historical Transactions Aggregation API allows businesses to collect and analyze historical transaction data for specific accounts. By providing the customer ID and account ID, users can submit requests to retrieve detailed historical transaction records. This API is designed for financial analysts, accountants, and customer service representatives who require insights into transaction patterns and trends over time. Typical use cases include generating reports for financial assessments, tracking spending behavior, and enhancing customer relationship management with data-driven insights.

post.summary: Retrieve historic transactions for a specified account.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all historic transactions associated with a specific account under a customer. It provides detailed information such as transaction amount, date, and status, which can be useful for auditing and account management purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a historic transaction for the specified account. It requires the relevant transaction details to be provided in JSON format.
